answerCheck.reason: For sin(2x), the least positive period is T = 2π/2 = π, so T/π = 1.
The coefficient A is 2, so the amplitude is |2| = 2, independently of the phase φ.
The angular coefficient is 2, giving T = 2π/|2| = π. Thus T/π = 1 for every real constant φ.
